overview: Claims Desk is a deployed governance service that separates deterministic claim validation from adversarial substantiation judgment. A registry handles hygiene checks via MCP tools while a script-orchestrated adversary argues evidence sufficiency, reducing coordination costs 2.

keyPoints.title: Deterministic checks separated from judgment verdicts
Script orchestration halves coordination token costs
Hygiene checks insufficient for substantiation verdicts
Test suite corrupted production data irreversibly
